title: Content
description: Build email and SMS templates to reach your subscribers, including product information and coupons to incentivize purchases.

top_articles.title: Getting started with coupon codes in Klaviyo
top_articles.description: Learn how to create and upload unique and static coupon codes in Klaviyo to incentivize customers to engage with your brand. Offering an incentive can help you improve the customer experience, resulting in higher sales and increased lifetime value.

top_articles.title: How to create unique coupon codes for Shopify
top_articles.description: Learn how to create single-use coupon codes for your Shopify store so that each customer receives their own unique coupon code for a given promotion on your site. This feature provides an alternative to creating a generic, also known as a static, coupon code, so you don't have to worry about codes being shared.

top_articles.title: How to set up coupons (for Magento 1.x)
top_articles.description: Magento supports Shopping Cart Price Rules that can be used to apply a discount to a customer's order. Coupon codes can be created for existing price rules, so that shoppers can easily leverage a given code to apply a discount during the checkout process.

top_articles.title: How to set up coupons for Magento 2
top_articles.description: Learn how to set up a price rule in Magento 2 and create the coupons in Klaviyo so that your shoppers can easily apply a discount during the checkout process. Magento supports shopping cart price rules.

top_articles.title: How to set up coupons for BigCommerce
top_articles.description: Learn how to set up BigCommerce coupon codes to use in Klaviyo emails and SMS so you can incentivize new subscriber and past customers to make a purchase. This guide will walk you through 2 methods for adding coupon codes to your emails:

top_articles.title: How to set up static coupons for WooCommerce
top_articles.description: Learn how to create and use static WooCommerce coupon codes to incentivize new sign-ups and encourage past customers to make another purchase.
